plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Small Business and Entrepreneurship, AA' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/small-business-and-entrepreneurship-aa/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Small Business and Entrepreneurship Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. The catalog defines its plan footnotes on this page: 3 = 'See approved General Education list for the AA/AS Degree', 4 = 'See program recommendations or requirements' — unspecified slots are modeled as choice slots with those definitions in choice_note; see advisor. Graduates are eligible for transfer to upper-division status in UNR's College of Business; students planning to transfer to UNR should complete MATH 176 or BUS 176. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid. This program can be completed online but may require in-person assignments or exams.
